info.name: GigSky Enterprise & IoT API
info.description: GigSky operates account-gated RESTful APIs for enterprise/IoT and partner/reseller customers via the GigSky Enterprise Manager (GEM) and IoT SIM Management portal. No public API reference, base URL, endpoints, schemas, or authentication scheme are documented as of 2026-06-21. This collection contains no executable requests; the folders mirror the conceptual API surfaces and any base URL is an illustrative, unverified placeholder. Reconcile against partner documentation obtained directly from GigSky.

items.docs: Conceptual surface for browsing regional/global eSIM data plans by destination and price zone. No endpoints are publicly documented.
Conceptual surface for eSIM/SIM provisioning, connectivity control, limits, sub-accounts, and OTA provisioning via GEM / IoT portal. No endpoints are publicly documented.
Conceptual surface for partner/enterprise order placement and fulfillment. No endpoints are publicly documented.
Conceptual surface for data-consumption and connectivity usage reporting per SIM, user group, sub-account, or pooled plan. No endpoints are publicly documented.
